plans.idea: Poster-scale centered stack: the headline gets a wide, tall band so it sets much larger than the current render, with the subheadline under it and the pill CTA centered on the same axis, plus tighter, even vertical spacing.

Left-aligned editorial block: the headline breaks into two big lines on the left two-thirds, and the CTA sits under it on the same left edge, so the open lime field on the right gives the type weight and room to breathe.

Banner read left to right: the headline and subheadline fill a large left column, and the CTA sits on the right at the column's vertical centre, so the eye goes message first and action last across the wide frame.
